Key Takeaways

  • Vacant Land Tax (VLT) applies to open plots without a building, assessed by GHMC/the local municipality.
  • A VLT assessment puts your plot on the municipal tax record and generates a payable tax identity.
  • Being on record helps establish possession and is often needed for later approvals and sales.
  • We create the VLT assessment and set up the record for your plot.
  • Handled remotely with your plot and ownership documents.

An open plot within municipal limits attracts Vacant Land Tax. Beyond the legal obligation, having a VLT assessment puts your plot on the municipal record — useful evidence of possession and often a prerequisite for later permissions and transactions.

JaaGa creates your VLT assessment with the relevant municipal body, so your vacant land is properly registered and compliant.

When You Need VLT Creation

When you own an open plot within GHMC or municipal limits that is not yet on the vacant-land tax record.

Before applying for building permissions, and to keep your plot's tax status clean ahead of a future sale.

Documents Required

  • Registered plot document / sale deed
  • Survey/plot number and extent
  • Owner identity proof
  • Layout / location details
  • Any prior tax reference (if available)

Common Problems We Solve

Plot not on municipal map

Newly formed plots may not be mapped. We establish the plot with the municipality.

Extent mismatches

Recorded extent may differ from the deed. We reconcile before assessment.

Jurisdiction confusion

Peripheral plots span GHMC vs municipality lines. We file with the correct body.

Why VLT Creation Matters

An unregistered vacant plot is a plot the municipality doesn't formally recognise as yours in its tax records — which weakens your possession and complicates permissions and sales. Creating the VLT record puts your plot on the books, in your name.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is VLT?

Vacant Land Tax — the municipal tax on open plots without a building, assessed by GHMC or the local municipality.

Why register a vacant plot for VLT?

It fulfils the tax obligation, puts your plot on the municipal record as evidence of possession, and is often needed for later approvals and sales.

Is VLT the same as PTIN?

They are related tax identities; VLT is for vacant land, while PTIN is the property tax identification typically for built property. We can help with both.

Can this be done remotely?

Yes. Share your plot and ownership documents on WhatsApp and we handle the filing.

What if my plot's extent is wrong in records?

We reconcile the recorded extent with your deed before the assessment is finalised.
